article.title: Attackers exploit critical Node-RED flaw to deploy Linux bot and backdoors (CVE-2026-58115)
article.summary: Attackers are exploiting an authentication flaw (CVE-2026-58115) in Node-RED, a programming tool built into some industrial control products, to install a Linux bot and backdoors on unprotected servers, VulnCheck has found. Node-RED is a flow-based programming tool built on Node.js that lets users wire together event-driven applications in a browser-based editor. article.title: Google dismantles massive botnet hidden in Android TV boxes
article.summary: The overwhelming majority of the infected devices in the X.CPE botnet are Android TV set-top boxes, Google said, adding that they observed a number of other infected Android-based IoT devices, including telehealth devices, karaoke machines and digital signage devices.

items.relevance_reason: Google triệt phá mạng lưới botnet X.CPE khổng lồ ẩn nấp trong các thiết bị Android TV box và nhiều thiết bị IoT khác.
